question:
An administrator has been tasked with scaling an existing VCF instance that consists of one workload domain that uses vSAN as its principal storage.
The following requirements must be met:
Add an additional workload domain.
Manage the new workload domain from the existing vCenter.
Which two actions must the administrator take to successfully complete the objective? (Choose two.)
options: A. Ensure the new workload domain uses the same SSO domain as the existing workload domains.
B. Ensure the existing workload domain uses the same NSX Manager as the management domain.
C. Ensure the new hosts are commissioned with the valid storage type and mapped to a network pool prior to domain creation.
D. Configure vCenter Enhanced Link-mode to link the two workload domain vCenters.
E. Ensure the new workload domain is configured using vSAN storage with compatible disks installed.
F. Create a vCenter Linking Group to link the two workload domain vCenters.

question:
An administrator successfully integrated VCF Operations fleet management with a Microsoft Certificate Authority and deployed certificates to vCenter, NSX, VCF Operations, and ESX hosts successfully in the past. VCF Operations fleet management has begun presenting errors that all certificates are nearing expiration no matter how often it is cleared. Examining the configuration the administrator sees that the automatic renew did successfully rotate certificates on all systems a week ago, and the certificate template is set to allow for all certificates to last one year.
What is the reason that certificates warnings are still being generated?
options: A. The Microsoft CA Root or Intermediate certificates are nearing expiration.
B. The certificate alert in VCF Operations has not been properly cleared.
C. SDDC Manager has lost contact with the Microsoft CA.
D. The administrator must manually click “Renew Certificate” on desired items.

question:
An administrator is responsible for scaling up VMware Cloud Foundation Operations vertically by using Fleet Management.
When the administrator initiates the Vertical Scale Up operation for the VCF Operations component, the workflow enters a “Needs Attention” state, indicating that the Fleet Management inventory information is not current.
Which action must the administrator take to allow the scale-up process to continue?
options: A. The administrator must take the VCF Operations cluster offline.
B. The administrator must take the mandatory snapshots.
C. The administrator must scale up the Cloud Proxies.
D. The administrator must perform the inventory sync.

question:
An administrator is trying to configure an action-based notification in VCF Operations. When trying to set the Outbound Method, the administrator is not able to continue.
What type of Plugin must the administrator configure to successfully compete the task?
options: A. Log File
B. SMTP Trap
C. Standard Email
D. Webhook (or SNMP/Action plugin depending on exact option)

question:
An administrator has been tasked with creating a custom group for NSX edges.
The first two NSX Edges have been tagged with the tag, nsx:edge.
The custom group has the following configuration:
Object Type = Edge Cluster
Membership Criteria:
Tag Category is nsx
Tag Value is edge
After 60 minutes the custom group still doesn’t list any members.
What action must the administrator take ensure that the custom group to populates correctly?
options: A. Change the Object Type from 'Edge Cluster' to 'NSX Edge' (or equivalent object type matching the tagged objects).
B. Restart the vCenter adapter.
C. Recreate the tag category.
D. Wait another 24 hours.

question:
An administrator is troubleshooting a certificate deployment failure in VCF Operations. The logs indicate that SDDC Manager could not communicate with the external certificate authority.
What is the most likely cause?
options: A. Firewall blocking outgoing traffic on port 443 to the CA.
B. Invalid CA credentials configured in SDDC Manager.
C. Expired API token.
D. All of the above.

question: Which action is required before replacing the certificate on a VCF Operations cluster node?
options: A. Put the node in maintenance mode.
B. Generate a valid Certificate Signing Request (CSR) matching the cluster FQDN/VIP.
C. Restart the database service.
D. Disable high availability.

question:
An administrator needs to manage dashboard ownership and sharing across multiple user groups in VCF Operations.
Within the Manage Dashboards panel, which step is part of transferring or sharing dashboards?
options: A. Within the Manage Dashboards panel, Export the dashboard configuration as JSON.
B. Within the Manage Dashboards panel, click the checkbox for the dashboard and use the sharing/permissions options to assign access.
C. Within the Manage Dashboards panel, Clone the dashboard for each user.
D. Within the Manage Dashboards panel, click “Change Owner” to reassign ownership.

question: Arrange the following steps in the correct order to schedule the delivery of a weekly report created in VCF Operations.
options: Step 1: Navigate to Dashboards/Reports and select the report template.
Step 2: Configure the schedule parameters (frequency, time, and recipients).
Step 3: Save and enable the scheduled report definition.

question: An administrator has been tasked with setting up Log Assist in VCF Operations for Logs.
options: A. Configure the vCenter and SDDC Manager credentials to allow automated bundle collection.
B. Manually upload logs via SSH.
C. Disable encryption on syslog ports.
D. Install agents on all physical switches.

question: An administrator is reviewing alert definitions in VCF Operations. What is the purpose of Symptom Definitions?
options: A. They define specific metric thresholds or events that, when triggered, contribute to an alert.
B. They act as automated remediation scripts.
C. They replace policies completely.
D. They define user access roles.

question:
An administrator has just deployed a VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) Private Cloud and now must ensure it is correctly licensed. The administrator has registered the VCF deployment with the VCF Business Services console and has downloaded the necessary license file and keys.
Which three products would be licensed using a license file? (Choose three.)
options: A. vSphere / ESXi
B. vCenter Server
C. NSX
D. SDDC Manager / VCF core components
E. Aria Operations
F. Storage arrays

question:
Log messages, especially errors, can be multiple lines.
What is the correct method to ensure that multi-line logs are captured properly as a single event?
options: A. Configure regex patterns in the agent configuration (e.g., liagent.ini) to detect the start of a new log entry.
B. Replace all newlines with spaces before writing to disk.
C. Configure syslog to drop multi-line logs.
D. Increase the buffer size only.

question: An administrator is configuring log forwarding from VCF Operations for Logs to a third-party SIEM. Which protocol and port are commonly used for secure syslog forwarding?
options: A. TCP / 514 or TLS / 6514
B. UDP / 514
C. HTTP / 80
D. FTP / 21

question: When configuring alert notifications in VCF Operations, which notification plug-in type allows sending alerts to external webhook endpoints?
options: A. Webhook plug-in
B. SNMP trap plug-in
C. Log file plug-in
D. Email plug-in

question: An administrator needs to back up the VCF Operations analytics cluster configuration. Which tool or mechanism is used?
options: A. The built-in Administration UI cluster backup functionality.
B. Manual file copy via SCP of the database files.
C. vCenter snapshot of the primary node only.
D. Database export using pg_dump.

question: What is the primary function of SDDC Manager in a VMware Cloud Foundation environment?
options: A. Automated lifecycle management, deployment, and configuration of the entire VCF stack.
B. Monitoring network traffic flows across physical switches.
C. Managing container clusters exclusively.
D. Providing desktop virtualization.

question: An administrator wants to ensure that VCF Operations automatically collects metrics from newly deployed virtual machines without manual intervention. How is this achieved?
options: A. Dynamic custom groups combined with active policies.
B. Manual addition of every VM to the inventory.
C. Restarting the vCenter adapter daily.
D. Configuring static IP routes.

question: Which log file on the SDDC Manager appliance is most useful when troubleshooting bring-up or domain creation failures?
options: A. /var/log/vmware/vcf/bringup/bringup.log
B. /var/log/messages
C. /var/log/auth.log
D. /var/log/syslog

question: What is a mandatory vSphere prerequisite for VCF Operations to perform Cross-Cluster Workload Optimization (moving a VM from Cluster A to Cluster B)?
options: A. The source and destination hosts must be connected to the same Shared Storage (or a shared datastore cluster), OR the environment must meet the requirements for vMotion without Shared Storage (x-vCenter vMotion requirements, routed vMotion network)
B. The clusters must be configured with "vSphere HA" Disabled.
C. The clusters must share the same vCenter Server.
D. The clusters must be in different Datacenters.

question:
A Director wants a monthly report quantifying the exact dollar savings achieved by the Operations team's reclamation efforts (e.g., "We saved $5,000 this month by deleting idle VMs").
Which VCF Operations construct natively provides this "Realized Savings" data?
options: A. The "Audit" log.
B. The vCenter Performance Charts.

C. The "Reclaimable Capacity" dashboard (or Cost Savings report) which calculates the cost of the reclaimed resources based on the configured Cost Drivers (Hardware/Storage cost) and tracks the potential vs. realized savings
D. The "Cluster Utilization" heatmap.

question:
A cluster is running a mix of "Test/Dev" workloads that are highly transient and often idle. The administrator wants to maximize density (VMs per host) and is willing to accept some performance risk.
Which capacity model setting supports this "High Density" goal?
options: A. Demand Model (allowing the system to pack VMs based on actual low usage).
B. Demand Model with a 50% Buffer.
C. Allocation Model with "Admission Control" enabled in vCenter.
D. Allocation Model with a 1:1 Ratio.

question:
A Cloud Admin is investigating why the Management Domain object in VCF Operations is showing a warning health state. The administrator examines the following log events and object hierarchy. (Select all that apply.)
# Log Events - Source: vcf-ops-analytics
[ERROR] Adapter instance [SDDC-Adapter] unable to retrieve health for object 'sddc-manager-01'.
[WARN] Collection cycle skipped for resource 'vcenter-mgmt-01' due to high latency (450ms).
# Object Hierarchy View
> VCF World
> Management Domain (sfo-m01)
[State: Warning]
> SDDC Manager
(sfo-m01-sddc01) [State: Unknown]
> vCenter
(sfo-m01-vc01) [State: Healthy]
> NSX Manager
(sfo-m01-nsx01) [State: Healthy]
Based on the logs and hierarchy, which statements accurately describe the root cause or impact?
options: A. The VCF Operations analytics cluster is down, preventing all data processing.
B. The NSX Manager is the root cause of the Management Domain warning due to a hidden critical alert.
C. The Management Domain object health is rolling up the "Unknown" state of the SDDC Manager as a "Warning" or degraded state.
D. The high latency on vCenter collection suggests a network bottleneck between the Cloud Proxy and the vCenter.
E. The SDDC Manager adapter instance is failing to collect data, causing the SDDC Manager object state to become "Unknown".

question:
A cluster currently shows "365+ Days Remaining" of capacity. The administrator modifies the Capacity Policy setting for "Time Remaining Calculation" from "Average Usage" to "Conservative".
# Result
The forecast immediately drops to "45 Days Remaining".
What does this drastic change indicate about the workload profile?
options: A. The new setting applied a 50% buffer to all resources.
B. The policy change corrupted the database.

C. The workloads exhibit high volatility (spiky behavior). The "Average" setting smoothed out the spikes, making the cluster look empty. The "Conservative" setting uses the upper-bound (Peak) usage values for calculation, revealing true resource exhaustion risks.
D. The cluster is oversized.

question:
A Capacity Planner is analyzing a "Capacity Critical" alert for a cluster.
# Metrics
CPU Demand: 30%
Memory Demand: 40%
Disk Space Demand: 35%
Disk I/O Latency: 25ms (Consistently high)
Why does the Capacity Engine NOT flag this cluster as "0 Days Remaining" based on the high Latency?
options: A. The cluster is licensed for "Standard" edition which excludes storage metrics.

B. By default, VCF Operations calculates capacity based on supply-constrained resources (CPU cycles, RAM GB, Disk GB). It typically treats Latency as a Performance/Health issue, not a Capacity (quantity) issue, unless a specific super-metric is used.
C. Latency is ignored because the administrator disabled the "Storage" management pack.
D. The Latency metric is stuck in the cache.

question:
A user asks: "Why does the 'Capacity Remaining' badge show 50% free, but the 'Reclaimable Capacity' badge shows 0 GB?"
# Context
Model: Demand
Cluster Utilization: 50%
VMs: All active, sized perfectly to their demand.
options: A. Reclaimable Capacity only updates monthly.
B. The Capacity Model is broken.
C. The cluster has free space for new workloads (Capacity Remaining), but the existing workloads are efficient and have no waste (oversized resources) to give back (Reclaimable).
D. The Allocation model is overriding the Demand model hiddenly.

question:
A customer asks if they can mix "Small" and "Medium" nodes in the same VCF Operations for Logs cluster to save costs during an expansion.
# Scenario
Existing: 3 x Medium Nodes
Proposed: Add 2 x Small Nodes
options: A. Yes, but the Small nodes can only be used as "Query Nodes", not "Ingestion Nodes".
B. No, unless "Storage Tiering" is enabled.

C. No, mixing node sizes is not supported. The cluster performance is dictated by the smallest node, and imbalance can cause ingestion queues to fill up on smaller nodes, causing dropped events for the whole cluster.
D. Yes, mixing sizes is fully supported and recommended for tiering.

question:
A Cloud Admin is reviewing the "High Availability" (HA) status of a single-site VCF Operations cluster.
# Cluster Status
Nodes: 4 (Node-A, Node-B, Node-C, Node-D)
HA State: Enabled
Roles:
Node-A: Master
Node-B: Master Replica
Node-C: Data
Node-D: Data
# Event
Node-C (Data Node) suffers a catastrophic hardware failure and goes offline.
What is the operational impact on the cluster?
options: A. Node-B automatically promotes itself to Master, and Node-A reboots to become a Data node.
B. The cluster goes into "Read-Only" mode until Node-C is restored from backup.
C. The cluster remains online. Metrics previously mastered on Node-C are served from their redundant copies on the other nodes. However, the cluster is now in a "Degraded" state.
D. The entire cluster goes offline because the loss of a Data node breaks the GemFire shard integrity.

question:
An administrator is troubleshooting a "Federation Connection Error" in the VCF Operations console. The "US-East" site is unable to display data from the "EU-West" member site.
# Federation Status
Member Site: EU-West
Status: Disconnected
Last Sync: 4 hours ago
# Troubleshooting Workbench - Connectivity Check
Source: US-East-Master-Node
Destination: EU-West-VIP (10.20.5.100)
Ping (ICMP): Success
Tracepath: Success
Curl (Port 443): Failed (Connection Refused)
Curl (Port 80): Success
Based on the diagnostic data, what is the most likely cause of the issue?
options: A. The "EU-West" site is in Maintenance Mode, which automatically disables ICMP responses but allows API calls.
B. The Federation API requires HTTPS (Port 443), but the firewall or service at the destination is blocking/refusing traffic on that port.
C. The Federation requires Port 80 for data transport, but the "Success" message indicates a false positive due to a caching bug.
D. The shared secret (passphrase) between the two sites has expired and needs rotation.

question: Which specific network requirement is critical for the stability of a VCF Operations Continuous Availability (CA) cluster?
options: A. The link must support Multicast routing for GemFire heartbeats.
B. The connection must support Jumbo Frames (MTU 9000).
C. Round-Trip Time (RTT) latency between the two fault domains must be less than 10ms (ideally <5ms).
D. A dedicated 100Gbps link is required.

question: A Cloud Admin logs into VCF Operations to manually free up storage space by deleting old snapshots identified as wasteful.
options: A. Dashboards -> Views -> Storage Reports.
B. Environment -> Object Browser -> Datastores -> Right Click "Delete All".

C. Optimize -> Reclaim (or Home -> Reclaim Capacity). From this dashboard, the admin can select the "Snapshots" tab, review the list of snapshots across the entire data center, and click "Delete Snapshots" to execute the cleanup.
D. Administration -> Management -> Global Settings -> Snapshots.

question:
A developer wants to import a directory of custom application logs (*.log) using the Importer. However, the application uses a non-standard timestamp format that VCF Operations for Logs does not automatically recognize.
How can the developer ensure the logs are indexed correctly?
options: A. Edit the source code of the application to change the timestamp format.

B. Provide a custom Parser Definition (in an INI file or manifest) to the Importer tool during execution. The Importer supports using Agent-compatible parsers to define the timestamp regex structure, ensuring correct time extraction during the import process.
C. The Importer only supports standard Syslog RFC 5424 formats.
D. Use sed to rewrite the logs before importing.

question:
In a distributed VCF Automation architecture, an administrator needs to manage a remote data center that is separated from the main management instance by a firewall with strict inbound blocking rules.
Which architectural component enables secure communication to the remote endpoint without opening inbound firewall ports?
options: A. A "Remote Collector" node.
B. A Standalone vRO Appliance.
C. A dedicated VPN tunnel.

D. The Cloud Proxy (or Extensibility Proxy). This appliance is deployed in the remote data center and establishes a secure unidirectional outbound connection (via WebSocket/HTTPS) to the central VCF Automation instance, allowing command execution.

question:
A Cloud Admin is tasked with monitoring a new remote "Edge Compute" site (Site-B) containing 50 hosts and 2000 VMs. The link between Site-B and the main data center (Site-A) has high latency (150ms) and limited bandwidth.
# Deployment Constraint
Site-A: VCF Operations Analytics Cluster (Primary)
Site-B: Remote vCenter Server and NSX Manager
# Requirement
Ensure reliable data collection from Site-B without overwhelming the WAN link during burst periods.
What is the recommended placement and configuration for the data collection components?
options: A. Deploy a full VCF Operations analytics node at Site-B and join it to the Site-A cluster to create a stretched cluster.
B. Deploy a Cloud Proxy at Site-B, target it to the Site-A cluster, and configure the Site-B adapters to use this Cloud Proxy.
C. Configure the Site-B vCenter adapter directly on the Site-A analytics cluster to avoid deploying additional appliances.
D. Deploy a Remote Collector at Site-B and configure a specialized WAN-compression plugin in the SDDC Manager.

question:
A Solution Architect is designing the integration strategy for a VCF environment that includes a "Stretched Cluster" Management Domain across two sites. The requirement is to ensure continuous monitoring of the Management vCenter even if Site 1 goes dark.
# Architecture
Site 1: Primary vCenter Node (Active)
Site 2: vCenter HA Node (Passive)
VCF Operations: Deployed in Site 1 (Standard Cluster)
# Issue
If Site 1 fails completely, VCF Operations (in Site 1) will also go down, failing to monitor the failover of vCenter to Site 2.
options: A. Deploy a VCF Operations Continuous Availability (CA) cluster stretched across Site 1 and Site 2, and configure the vCenter Adapter to run on a Collector Group containing Cloud Proxies from both sites.
B. Install a standalone VCF Operations node in Site 2 and use "vSphere Replication" to keep it synced with Site 1.
C. Configure vCenter HA to automatically vMotion the VCF Operations Analytics nodes to Site 2.
D. Use the "SDDC Manager Integration" to proxy the vCenter metrics, as SDDC Manager is automatically highly available.

question: In VCF Automation Assembler, what is the specific logical component that groups compute resources (like vSphere Clusters or AWS Regions) and assigns them to specific Projects for consumption?
options: A. Image Mapping.

B. Cloud Zone. A Cloud Zone is a slice of compute capacity. It is defined within a specific Cloud Account (e.g., "Cluster-A" in vCenter) and then "shared" with Projects. This controls where a project is allowed to deploy workloads.
C. Capability Tag.
D. Flavor Mapping.

question: A security team requires that all deployed web servers must automatically have the "Apache" software installed and be continuously monitored to ensure the configuration does not drift (e.g., if a user stops the service, it is restarted automatically).
options: A. VCF Automation Orchestrator.

B. VCF Automation Config (formerly SaltStack Config). This component uses an event-driven automation engine to deploy software, manage OS configurations, and enforce compliance (State) across the deployed inventory.
C. VCF Automation Pipelines.
D. VCF Automation Assembler.

question:
An operator needs to ensure that a scheduled "Downsize CPU" job in Automation Central typically requires approval before execution, EXCEPT for the "Dev-Test" cluster where it should run automatically.
# Policy Requirement
Prod Cluster: Email approval required.
Dev-Test Cluster: Fully automated.
How can the operator implement this differentiation?
options: A. Create two separate Jobs: One for Prod with the "Email Notification Plugin" configured, and one for Dev-Test.

B. This is controlled by the "Automation Policy" settings in VCF Operations, where the "Automate" flag is enabled for the Dev-Test scope and disabled (or set to "Manual") for the Prod scope, which Automation Central respects.
C. Automation Central does not support approval workflows; all jobs run automatically once scheduled.
D. This logic is handled in the Automation Central Job definition by setting the "Recurrence" to "Manual" for Prod.

question: An operator wants to reclaim resources from a virtual machine labeled as "Idle". However, the operator is unsure if the VM is truly unused and wants to check the historical CPU usage trend before deleting it, without leaving the Reclaim screen.
options: A. The "VMRC Console" launch button.
B. The "Ping" tool.
C. The "Export to CSV" button.

D. The "VM Details" (or toggle graph) view within the Reclaim list. By clicking on the VM name or the expand arrow, the user can see a trend chart of CPU/Memory usage over the analysis period (e.g., last 30 days) to confirm idleness.

question:
Cloud-Proxy-Secure-01 (Dedicated to Isolated Net)
What is the impact of selecting "Cloud-Proxy-Secure-01" for this integration?
options: A. It restricts the integration to only collect data from objects named "Secure".
B. It pins the data collection traffic for this specific vCenter to flow exclusively through Cloud-Proxy-Secure-01, ensuring connectivity rules (Isolated Net -> Proxy -> Analytics) are respected.
C. It forces the VCF Operations Analytics nodes to bypass the proxy and talk directly to the vCenter.
D. It automatically encrypts the vCenter database.

question:
A user complains that they cannot find logs for a specific ESXi host in VCF Operations for Logs. The administrator checks the ESXi host configuration and sees: Syslog.global.logHost = udp://loginsight.corp.local:514
A packet capture on the Log Insight node shows packets arriving from the ESXi host IP on port 514.
Why are the logs still not searchable in the UI?
options: A. The Log Insight license has expired.
B. The indexer service is stopped.
C. The ESXi host is in Maintenance Mode.
D. The logs are being dropped because the ESXi host's time is significantly skewed (Time Drift) relative to the Log Insight cluster, putting the timestamps outside the query window.

question: A Cloud Admin believes that the default "Idle VM" detection is too aggressive, flagging VMs that are actually doing light work (using 200 MHz CPU). The admin wants to raise the threshold so that a VM is only considered "Idle" if it uses less than 100 MHz.
options: A. In the vCenter Server "Advanced Settings".
B. In the active Policy assigned to the VMs, specifically under the "Reclaimable Capacity" section.
C. In the Automation Central job wizard.
D. In the "Global Settings" menu under "System Defaults".

question: Which communication protocol does the VCF Operations for Logs Agent use by default to transmit logs to the server, offering features like compression and SSL encryption?
options: A. SNMP Trap (162).
B. UDP Syslog (514).
C. TCP Syslog (514).

D. CFAPI (Common Forwarding API). This proprietary protocol typically runs over port 9000 (non-SSL) or 9543 (SSL), providing a more robust, efficient, and secure delivery mechanism compared to standard syslog.

question: What is the primary function of the VCF Installer Appliance (formerly VMware Cloud Builder) in the VMware Cloud Foundation architecture?
options: A. To continuously monitor the health of the physical hardware after deployment.
B. To act as a permanent gateway for all North-South traffic entering the SDDC.
C. To provide a centralized repository for ISO images and VM templates for Day 2 operations.
D. To automate the "Day 0" bring-up process, deploying the Management Domain and transferring control to SDDC Manager.

question:
A Security Auditor wants to review all logs where a specific field user_id is present in the log entry, regardless of what the actual user ID value is. This is to identify all authenticated activities.
Which filter operator supports this requirement?
options: A. starts with "user"
B. contains
C. is not null

D. exists. The administrator selects the field user_id and chooses the operator exists. This filters the view to show only those log events where the parser successfully extracted a value for that field.

question:
A team uses Ansible (Open Source) heavily for application configuration. They want to drag-and-drop their existing Ansible Playbooks onto the VCF Automation design canvas to run post-provisioning tasks on new VMs.
Which prerequisite must be met to enable this capability?
options: A. Configure an Ansible Integration in Assembler and specify the "Ansible Control Machine" (host) where the playbooks reside. This integration allows the canvas to inventory the playbooks and execute them via SSH/WinRM.
B. Convert all Playbooks to vRO Workflows.
C. Enable "Cloud-Init".
D. Install the Ansible agent on every VM template.

question: Which prerequisite is required for VCF Operations to successfully execute a "Power Off" or "Delete" action on a VM?
options: A. The VCF Operations "Action Service" must be stopped.
B. The user must be logged in as root.

C. The vCenter Adapter Instance must be configured with "Enable Actions = True", and the credential used by the adapter must have the necessary vSphere permissions (e.g., VirtualMachine.Interact.PowerOff) to perform the task.
D. The Cloud Proxy must have SSH enabled.

question:
An administrator needs to view logs for either app=SQL OR app=Oracle. By default, adding two filters in the top bar (app=SQL and app=Oracle) creates an AND condition, resulting in zero logs (since an app cannot be both at once).
How can the administrator create an OR condition?
options: A. Use the "Advanced Query" CLI.
B. Type SQL || Oracle in the search bar.
C. It is not possible; you must create two separate dashboards.
D. Click the "Group Filters" toggle (or equivalent UI mechanism for adding a filter group) and set the group logic to OR.

question: Which component serves as the Centralized Identity Provider (IdP) for VCF Automation, handling user authentication, directory synchronization from Active Directory/LDAP, and Single Sign-On (SSO) tokens?
options: A. The internal PostgreSQL database.
B. Workspace ONE Access (formerly VMware Identity Manager).
C. The vCenter Single Sign-On (PSC) service directly.
D. The VCF Automation Assembler service.

question:
A Cloud Admin observes that the "Time Remaining" capacity projections for a cluster fluctuate wildly.
# Investigation
- Metric Retention Policy: 6 Months
- Capacity Calculation Model: Demand
- Time Remaining Criteria: Conservative
# Recent Change
The "Historical Data Consideration" setting in the Capacity Policy was changed from "All" (6 months) to "Last 30 Days".
How does this policy change affect the accuracy and stability of the retention/capacity forecast?
options: A. It has no effect; retention policies determine storage, not calculation scope.

B. It improves stability by ignoring old, irrelevant data spikes from 5 months ago, making the projection more focused, OR if the 30-day window contains anomalous temporary spikes, it can cause fluctuation because the sample size is too short to build a stable trend line.
C. It forces the system to delete the 5 months of data physically from the disk.
D. It causes the fluctuation because "30 Days" is too short of a sample size to build a reliable trend line.

question:
Source: Cloud Proxy (DMZ) -> Dest: VCF Ops Cluster (Internal) | Port: 22 | Action: Deny
Which feedback should the VCF Architect provide to the security team regarding this rule set?
options: A. Rule #3 is incorrect; Port 22 must be open for the Cluster to push upgrade binaries to the Proxy.

B. Rule #2 is unnecessary and should be removed. The Cloud Proxy architecture relies on a "One-Way Outbound" connection initiated by the Proxy to the Cluster. The Cluster does not need to initiate connections into the DMZ.
C. The design is perfect; bidirectional HTTPS is required for heartbeat exchange.
D. A new rule must be added to allow Port 80 for insecure bootstrap.

question: To achieve High Availability (HA) for a production VCF Automation deployment, what is the minimum required node count for the core cluster?
options: A. 1 Node with vSphere HA enabled.
B. 2 Nodes.
C. 5 Nodes.

D. 3 Nodes. A 3-node cluster is required to establish quorum for the underlying services (like Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and RabbitMQ). These nodes are placed behind a Load Balancer (VIP) which distributes user traffic across the active nodes.

question: A Security Architect is designing the identity management strategy for a new VCF Operations deployment. The organization enforces a policy that "No application-specific local user accounts are allowed for day-to-day administration."
options: A. Configure an Identity Source (LDAP/Active Directory) within the VCF Identity Broker (or directly in VCF Operations depending on version), import the relevant AD User Groups, and assign VCF Operations Roles to those imported groups.
B. Enable the "Local Guest" account and rename it to match the administrator's ID.
C. Create a shared local account.
D. Manually recreate every AD user in the VCF Operations local database with a matching password.

question: Which specific prerequisite must be verified before running the "Add Node" wizard in the VCF Operations cluster?
options: A. The new node VM must be powered off.
B. The new node must be deployed, powered on, and the "Initial Setup Wizard" (Install/Expand/New) must be waiting at the "Get Started" screen; it should not yet be configured as a standalone cluster.
C. The Master Node must be in Maintenance Mode.
D. The new node must already have a valid license key applied via CLI.

question: An administrator configures Data Archiving to an NFS share. One weekend, the NFS server crashes and remains offline for 48 hours. During this time, the VCF Operations for Logs cluster continues to ingest heavy log traffic, filling the local disks to capacity.
options: A. The system caches the data in RAM until the NFS server returns.
B. The system stops ingesting new logs to preserve the un-archived data (Backpressure).

C. The system generates an alert, but continues to ingest new data. To free up space for the new logs, it deletes the oldest local log buckets, even if they have not yet been successfully archived. This results in permanent data loss for unarchived logs.
D. The system automatically switches to the secondary archive target.

question: A "VCF Assessment" report indicates that the VCF Installer Appliance was used to deploy the environment but was never patched. Does this pose a security risk to the running SDDC?
options: A. Yes, because it is the active authentication gateway for vCenter.
B. Yes, because SDDC Manager relies on the Installer Appliance database for password rotation.
C. No, provided it is powered off or isolated; it does not play an active role in the runtime security or operation of the running SDDC.
D. Yes, because it actively manages the NSX firewalls.

question:
A CIO asks the operations team to provide a "Green Score" dashboard to track the environmental efficiency and power consumption of the VCF data centers.
# Requirement
- Track Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE)
- Identify "Zombie" VMs wasting energy
- Quantify Carbon Footprint savings from reclamation
options: A. SDDC Manager
B. VCF Operations
C. VMware Aria Suite Lifecycle
D. VCF Operations for Networks

question:
A VCF Operations cluster is running with 8 nodes (the maximum for the current sizing standard used by the customer). The environment continues to grow, and the cluster is hitting CPU contention.
# Constraints
- Scale-Out limit reached (per internal policy).
- Current Node Size: Medium (8 vCPU).
# Goal
Increase compute capacity without adding more VM instances (nodes).
Which scaling method is applicable?
options: A. Vertical Scale-Up: Shut down the cluster, increase the vCPU and RAM settings on all nodes to the "Large" or "Extra-Large" sizing tier following official sizing guidelines.
B. There is no solution; data must be deleted.
C. Enable "Hyper-Threading" on the VCF Operations application settings.
D. Deploy a second separate VCF Operations cluster and use Federation.

question:
A Cloud Admin is reviewing the inventory of a newly deployed VMware Cloud Foundation instance to verify the correct placement of appliances.
# VCF Inventory - Appliance List
vm-01: sddc-manager-01 (Power State: On)
vm-02: vcenter-mgmt-01 (Power State: On)
vm-03: nsx-manager-01 (Power State: On)
vm-04: nsx-edge-01 (Power State: On)
vm-05: vcenter-wld-01 (Power State: On)
vm-06: aria-ops-01 (Power State: On)
Which of the listed appliances primarily reside within the Management Domain's vSphere cluster?
options: A. All listed appliances (vm-01 through vm-06)
B. vm-01, vm-02, vm-03, vm-05, and vm-06
C. vm-01, vm-02, vm-03, and vm-04 only
D. vm-01, vm-02, vm-03, and vm-06 only

question:
A Cloud Admin is reviewing the data collection status for a large vSAN cluster. The "Collection Interval" for the vCenter Adapter is set to the default value.
# Adapter Configuration
Name: VC-Adapter-SFO
Collection Interval: 5 minutes
# Observation
A critical vSAN latency spike occurred at 10:02 AM.
The VCF Operations dashboard shows data points at 10:00 AM and 10:05 AM, but missed the peak spike at 10:02 AM.
options: A. The "Real-Time" button in the dashboard was not clicked.
B. vSAN metrics are only collected once every 60 minutes by design to save storage.
C. The Cloud Proxy was rebooting during the spike.

D. VCF Operations collects metrics as point-in-time snapshots based on the defined interval (5 mins); it does not stream continuous real-time data, so transient spikes between intervals may be averaged out or missed.

question: Which three primary components are typically contained within a VCF Operations for Logs Content Pack?
options: A. Dashboards, Extracted Fields, and Alerts. A Content Pack bundles the visualization (Dashboards), the parsing logic (Extracted Fields), and the monitoring logic (Alerts/Queries) for a specific technology domain.
B. Virtual Machines, vSwitches, and Datastores.
C. Agents, Collectors, and Load Balancers.
D. Firmware, Drivers, and BIOS updates.

question:
A VCF Operator observes that a specific "Test-VM" has been deleted from vCenter, but it is still appearing in VCF Operations dashboards with a status of "Not Existing". The operator wants to manually remove this stale object from the inventory immediately, rather than waiting for the automatic cleanup interval.
# Object Details
Name: Test-VM
Status: Not Existing
Collection State: Not Collecting
options: A. Right-click the object in the "Environment" view and select "Delete Object".
B. Go to Administration -> Inventory -> Object Deletion Schedule and run "Delete Now".
C. Restart the Collector service to flush the cache.
D. Go to Administration -> Management -> Inventory (or Object List), select the object, and click the "Delete Object" button.

question:
A "Dev-Ops" team complains that their "CI/CD-Build" VMs are constantly appearing in the "Oversized" reclamation list because they run at 100% CPU for 1 hour a day but are idle the rest of the time. They do not want these downsized.
What is the correct configuration strategy to stop VCF Operations from recommending downsizing for these specific VMs?
options: A. Disable the "Capacity Engine" globally.
B. Use the "Exclusion" tag in vCenter.
C. Delete the VMs from VCF Operations.
D. Create a Custom Group for "CI/CD VMs", create a specific Policy that disables "Rightsizing" (or sets it to be extremely conservative), and assign that Policy to the Custom Group.

question:
A company wants to grant the "Application Owners" group the ability to create their own Custom Groups and Dashboards, but NOT allow them to modify Global Settings or Adapters.
Which role permission bit enables this "Content Creation" capability without full Admin rights?
options: A. Content -> Create/Edit
B. Environment -> Inventory -> Manage
C. Global -> Health -> Manage
D. Administration -> Access Control -> Manage

question:
An operator reports that they cannot log in to VCF Operations using their domain credentials (user@corp.local).
# Diagnostic Data
- Local admin@local login: Success
- SDDC Manager login with user@corp.local: Failed
- Error Message: "Identity Broker Service Unavailable"
# Service Status (SDDC Manager VM)
vcf-idb-service: Stopped
postgresql: Running
What is the impact of the vcf-idb-service being stopped on the VCF environment?
options: A. All VMs in the Workload Domains will lose network connectivity.

B. Authentication for VCF Operations, SDDC Manager, and other integrated components using federated/external identities will fail. Local emergency accounts may still work if they bypass the broker (depending on config).
C. VCF Operations will stop collecting metrics from vCenter.
D. vCenter Server will disconnect all ESXi hosts.

question:
An application developer wants to monitor a specific log file located at /opt/app/logs/server.log on a Linux VM.
What specific configuration section must be added to the Log Insight Agent to enable this collection?
options: A. [syslog_forward]
B. [winlog]
C. [network_monitor]

D. [filelog]. This section requires a unique name (e.g., [filelog|MyCustomApp]) and a directory path specification. It tells the agent to tail the specified file(s) and forward new lines to the server.

question: An analyst is viewing a "Web Server Activity" dashboard that contains 12 different widgets showing various metrics (Error Codes, Latency, User Agents) for all web servers. The analyst wants to filter every widget on the dashboard to show data for only server-01, without editing each widget individually.
options: A. Zoom in on the time range.
B. Use the "Interactive Analytics" tab to run 12 separate queries.

C. Use the Dashboard Filter (Global Filter) located at the top of the dashboard page. By adding a filter condition hostname = server-01 here, the system dynamically propagates this constraint to all applicable widgets on the current dashboard.
D. Edit the dashboard XML source code.

question:
A VCF Operator notices that a vCenter Server adapter instance has transitioned to a "Collection Failed" state. The error message displayed in the interface is "401 Unauthorized".
What is the most common root cause and the correct remediation step?
options: A. The service account password used by the adapter has expired or was changed in the target Active Directory/vSphere domain. The operator must Update the Credential in the adapter configuration with the new valid password.
B. The collector service has crashed; restart the VCF Operations Analytics service.
C. The firewall is blocking port 443.
D. The vCenter Server certificate has expired; regenerate the certificate.

question:
A VCF Operator needs to analyze a 2 GB .tgz support bundle collected from an ESXi host that crashed and was subsequently rebuilt. The logs inside the bundle are from last week.
Which tool is specifically designed to ingest this offline, historical archive into VCF Operations for Logs for analysis?
options: A. vRealize Orchestrator.

B. The Log Insight Importer (or li-importer). This standalone command-line utility reads local files (including recursive archives like .zip/.tgz) and pushes them to the Log Insight server via the ingestion API, preserving the historical timestamps.
C. The Log Insight Agent.
D. The "Interactive Analytics" upload button.

question: What is the next step to make the application utilize the new space after expanding a virtual disk on a VCF Operations node?
options: A. The application automatically detects the hot-add and expands the filesystem online without any user intervention.
B. Reboot the nodes; the system auto-expands the filesystem on boot.
C. Log in to the VCF Operations for Logs UI, go to the "System Monitor" or "Cluster" page, and enable the option to "Expand Storage".
D. Run fdisk and resize2fs manually on the SSH console of each node.

question: An admin runs a What-If Analysis to remove a Host from a cluster to simulate a hardware refresh cycle. The result shows a "Capacity Shortfall" of 10% for Memory.
options: A. The host can be removed, but VCF Operations will automatically disable HA to make it fit.
B. The host can be removed, but users will experience slow performance.
C. The host can be removed safely because the shortfall is within the 10% buffer.

D. The host cannot be safely removed without violating the capacity policy (Buffers/HA). The remaining hosts do not have enough "Usable Memory" to run the existing workloads while satisfying the configured admission control and buffer requirements.

question: Which statement accurately differentiates VCF Operations for Networks from VCF Operations (Metrics) regarding network visibility?
options: A. VCF Operations (Metrics) analyzes IPFIX flows in real-time to detect DDoS attacks.
B. VCF Operations for Networks is only for physical switches; VCF Operations is only for virtual switches.
C. Both tools provide identical flow analysis capabilities; the difference is only in the licensing.

D. VCF Operations (Metrics) focuses on the health of the network components (e.g., Dropped Packets % on a vNIC), whereas VCF Operations for Networks focuses on the traffic patterns (Who is talking to Whom, over which port, and application-to-application paths).

question: Which adapter instance must be configured to meet vSAN storage monitoring requirements in VCF Operations?
options: A. vSAN Storage Adapter
B. Storage Devices Adapter
C. vCenter Adapter
D. VCF Infrastructure Adapter

question:
After successfully adding two new Data Nodes to the cluster, the administrator notices that the disk usage on the new nodes is near 0%, while the old nodes are still at 80%.
Which system process must complete to resolve this imbalance?
options: A. The administrator must manually vMotion the VMDKs to balance storage.
B. The system requires a "Full Restart" of the cluster to recognize the new disk space.
C. The "Garbage Collection" process, which runs nightly.
D. The "Rebalance" (GemFire Rebalancing) operation. In modern versions, this often starts automatically or is triggered via the Admin UI to redistribute the existing metric shards onto the new nodes.

question:
An administrator needs to apply a new License Key to the VCF Operations instance to unlock "Enterprise" features after a POC.
# License Info
Key: AAAA-BBBB-CCCC-DDDD
Edition: Enterprise
options: A. Administration -> Access -> Roles.
B. Administration -> Management -> Licensing.
C. Configure -> Licensing -> vSphere.
D. SDDC Manager -> Repository -> Bundles.

question: A VCF Operations for Logs cluster is configured with an "Ingestion API" alert to notify admins when the ingestion rate drops to 0 (indicating a potential outage). However, the admin wants to prevent this alert from firing during the scheduled weekly maintenance window (Sundays 2am-4am).
options: A. There is no maintenance schedule feature in Log Insight natively for specific alerts in the UI (unlike VCF Ops Policies). The standard operational approach involves manual disabling or external suppression.
B. In the "General User" alert profile.
C. Utilize the "Disable Alert" feature in the Alert Definition list.
D. Use a Cron job to stop the service.

question:
A deployment of VCF Operations for Networks is using "Pinning" to associate specific data sources with specific collectors.
# Scenario
Collector-A: Pinned to vCenter-Prod (High Load)
Collector-B: Pinned to vCenter-Test (Low Load)
# Alert
Collector-A is dropping flows due to overload (CPU 100%).
Collector-B is idle (CPU 10%).
options: A. Delete Collector-A; the system will auto-magic the load.
B. Disable IPFIX on the Distributed Switch for vCenter-Prod.
C. Enable "Distributed Collection" or manually re-pin some of the data sources (e.g., move vCenter-Prod to Collector-B, or split if supported/granular) to utilize the idle capacity of Collector-B.
D. Increase the polling interval on vCenter-Prod to 60 minutes.

question: A Cloud Admin is tasked with "Right-Sizing" the virtual machines in a new VCF Workload Domain to reduce wasted resources.
options: A. SDDC Manager
B. VCF Automation
C. VCF Operations
D. VMware NSX

question:
A custom application generates logs with the format: [2023-10-01] ERROR User:John Doe Module:Login. The administrator creates a custom Extracted Field named app_user using the regex User:(\w+).
When does this extraction occur?
options: A. It occurs on the Server's disk when the log is written (Write-Time).
B. It occurs on the Agent before sending.
C. It requires a server reboot to apply.

D. It occurs On-the-Fly (Query-Time). When a user runs a query or loads a dashboard, the system applies the regex to the stored raw text to extract the value. This allows retroactive field extraction on historical data without re-indexing.
